admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent; credit hour system; minimum percentage varies by major

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: 300 - 3,600 JOD (per semester, estimated based on credit hour rates)
tuition_fees.notes: Per-credit-hour fees range from 10 JOD (Sharia and Islamic Studies) to 120 JOD (Doctor of Pharmacy); discounts available for high-achieving students including 50% off for 90%+ Tawjihi, 25% off for 80-89% Tawjihi; siblings discount; free transportation and Wi-Fi for all students; students who fall below 68% GPA after first two semesters lose discount eligibility; Syrian and Egyptian nationals pay reduced flat fees

ranking_accreditation.national_ranking: 1st in northern Jordan (THE Impact Rankings 2026); 21st globally in Quality Education
ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan; ASIC International; ACPE Accredited (Pharmacy); Union of Arab Universities; International Association of Universities (IAU); Federation of the Universities of the Islamic World (FUIW)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS World University Rankings 2026: 1401+; QS World University Rankings 2027: 1201-1400; THE Impact Rankings 2026: 1st in northern Jordan, 21st globally in Quality Education; Webometrics 2026: Global 5007; GreenMetric World University Rankings

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: On-campus housing for female students: 10 buildings with 42 studios, 667 rooms, and 12 apartments, accommodating over 1,300 female students under supervision of 48 supervisors
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Refa'iy Marashdeh Grant (50,000 JOD annually for students in need); DAFI scholarships for Syrian and Iraqi refugees; full coverage for top 10 Tawjihi achievers; 50% discount for 90%+ Tawjihi; 25% for 80-89%; siblings discounts; poor student fund; free transportation and health insurance
campus_facilities.sports_hall: The Arena - one of the largest indoor sports halls in Jordan

contact_info.address: International Highway (Irbid/Amman), Aljaza'er Street, Nuaimeh, Irbid, Jordan
